objective.statement: Give Codex sessions one native owner for daemon package selection and lifecycle.
objective.measure: The native daemon owns its production package and updater; .dotfiles retires its standalone launcher and direct-restart timer; CLI, managed package, and running server agree and /model lists GPT-6.1-Sol.

need.statement: Give Codex sessions one native owner for daemon package selection and lifecycle.
stakeholders: Mikael and the shared Codex TUI sessions on cc-se-sto-devbox-01.
need.baseline: codex app-server daemon version reports managedCodexVersion=0.157.1 while cliVersion and appServerVersion are 0.159.2; codex-managed-daemon.service launches standalone/current and an hourly timer owns direct restarts.
need.consequence_of_no_action: Native daemon diagnostics continue to describe an unused stale package, while Home Manager and Codex have overlapping lifecycle ownership.
alternatives_considered: Use supported native bootstrap and package update commands

purpose: Give Codex sessions one native owner for daemon package selection and lifecycle.
consumer: Mikael and the shared Codex TUI sessions on cc-se-sto-devbox-01.
contract: The native daemon owns its production package and updater; .dotfiles retires its standalone launcher and direct-restart timer; CLI, managed package, and running server agree and /model lists GPT-6.1-Sol.
failure_boundary: Migration may disconnect attached Codex turns; source and logs persist, and the separate migration unit must complete native bootstrap even when the old daemon exits.

evidence.description: The runtime checker proves package/version agreement, native executable ownership, remote control enabled, and retirement of custom systemd units.

falsifier.claim: Codex native management owns the running shared daemon after migration.

executable_check.description: Any mismatch in CLI/managed/server versions, active legacy unit, or executable outside app-server-daemon/current falsifies the migration.

non_goals: Change default model or reasoning settings
Change authentication, MCP registration, or the masked guardian
invariants: Exactly one shared daemon owns the Codex socket
Native package diagnostics describe the executable actually running
Unrelated primary checkout edits are preserved

assumptions.statement: Native bootstrap can own a Linux daemon without the custom standalone systemd launcher.
assumptions.falsifier: Native bootstrap fails or returns a daemon that cannot reconnect normal TUI sessions.

run_control.reason: Operator explicitly requested replacing the custom daemon management with native Codex management.
